# The Zizkian

A framework for readings that can lose. Version 0.3.0, experimental.
Public home: https://maciejjankowski.com/zizkian/
Author: Maciej Jankowski.

The Prolog checker validates declarations and relationships in a reasoning
record. It does not verify source truth, consent or test quality. No finding is
valid. Authored attention weights are excluded from decision authority.
No controlled outcome benchmark is claimed. Every report says evidence_verified
is false and a passing verdict is awaiting human review. The attention matrix
belongs only to an optional historical conceptual appendix.

govern permissions. The licensing polemic is the project's ethical argument.
